scenarios.scenario-1: Version parsing/ranges are exact: octocode 0.29.2 satisfies >=0.29 <0.30, 0.28.9 and 0.30.0 do not; two- and three-component bounds and integer bounds (>=3.3 <4) parse identically.
scenarios.scenario-2: Detection order config → env → PATH is proven with fake executables; the kill switch and enabled:false disable tools without findings, while enabled:true turns a missing tool into a warning.
scenarios.scenario-3: `mygrace integrations status` always exits 0, prints the ADR-8 envelope in JSON mode and an honest table in text mode, including install hints for missing optional tools.
scenarios.scenario-4: Invalid integrations.* config is a CONFIG_INVALID ConfigError (exit 2) listing every problem; a broken probe (bad --version output) is reported as unavailable/unsupported, never as an exception in core commands.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text/JSON output asserted by tests; library paths emit no runtime log markers.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-integrations.test.ts (helpers, detection, kill switch, status command) and the integrations block of test/grace-config.test.ts.
notes.note-2: ADR-9 invariants checked here: no network in detection, argv-only probes, scrubbed child env, pinned tested range, advisory exit 0.
notes.note-3: CLI surface: mygrace integrations status [--path .] [--format text|json]; env: MYGRACE_INTEGRATIONS, MYGRACE_OCTOCODE_BIN, MYGRACE_ARCHIFY_BIN.
